description: This PHP class QuickCreateMetaParser extends MetaParser to parse and generate metadata definitions for SugarCRM's QuickCreate form views from HTML files. It includes methods for parsing HTML contents to extract form fields, buttons, hidden inputs, and constructs the metadata array accordingly.

classes.name: QuickCreateMetaParser
classes.description: A parser class designed to convert HTML form layouts of the QuickCreate view into SugarCRM metadata definitions, supporting pre-5.0 SugarCRM HTML structures.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parser with the view type 'QuickCreate'.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main method that reads an HTML file, extracts form and table elements, fields, buttons, and hidden inputs, and constructs a metadata array representing the view configuration.
